notes.title: The Humble Brawler Bundle doesn t contain much brawling, but is a great fighting game starter pack
notes.notes:
It’s not just me, right? A brawler (also known a beat-em-up) is a game in the vein of Final Fight or Streets Of Rage, no? A duo or trio of co-op heroes against waves of expendable mooks? Well, the Humble Brawler Bundle doesn’t contain any of those.

What it does contain is a great selection of fighting games to start off the collection of someone looking to get into the genre, mostly focused around the back-catalogue of Arc System Works, who recently shook up the scene with Dragon Ball FighterZ.

It also contains a lot of Anime, with a capital A. You have been warned.

notes.title: Crowdfunding campaign for the next Arcana Heart game
notes.notes:
The crowdfunding campaign on Kickstarter is ending soon!

The goal is to localize and port the latest of the Arcana Heart series, "Arcana Heart 3 LOVE MAX SixStarS!!!!!!", including the new character,
Minori Amanohara, and a new arcana, Ichor, the Arcana of Blood, both of which were previously only available in Japanese arcade machines.

The initial goal was reached in just under four days, and the first stretch goal, the addition a new arcana, Paracelsia, was also achieved.

Pledge to the Kickstarter campaign, and you can pre-order your copy
of SixStarS!!!!! AND get the new character for FREE (it will be
released as a DLC for the game once it hits the Steam Store)!

There are many more cool rewards, including some exclusive merchandise to this campaign.

Do check out the Kickstarter page, and don't miss your opportunity!

The campaign runs until August 2nd, 2017.

Kickstarter page:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/99831120/arcana-heart-3-love-max-six-stars-2d-fighting-game

notes.title: Nitroplus Blasterz: Heroines Infinite Duel Coming To PC
notes.notes:
I’m glad to see more Japanese fighting games come over from consoles because 1) they’re a genre and origin traditionally under-represented here; 2) sometimes they are super weird and I adore that. So coo ‘eck, crossover fighting game Nitroplus Blasterz: Heroines Infinite Duel [official site] is coming to Windows this winter.

Made by Arcana Heart developers Examu, it brings together ladies from visual novel studio Nitroplus’s games, including licensed games. Expect witches, warriors, a schoolgirl with a baseball bat, a rozzer from Psycho-Pass, someone on a hang glider, and a lady followed by a swarm of cute cats. Amazing scenes. Watch this:

notes.title: v1.04 アップデート(10月28日)
notes.notes:
●[OPTION]の[DISPLAY OPTION]に[アンチエイリアス]の設定項目を追加しました。 
　設定できる値は、「4x」、「2x」、「OFF」です。 
　アンチエイリアスの設定はゲーム中の描画処理に影響し、「4x」が最も滑らかで、「OFF」が最も粗くなります。 
　通常は「4x」に設定してありますが、ゲームプレイ中の処理が重く感じた場合は、「2x」もしくは「OFF」に変更してみてください。

notes.title: v1.04 Patch (28 Oct)
notes.notes:
- Added option to toggle Anti-Alias, under "Option" > "Display Option" > "Anti-Alias". Users can choose between "OFF", "2x" and "4x". 
The default value is "4x", where the drawings of the game are displayed to be the smoothest, but if players are experiencing game slow-downs, kindly turn the Anti-Alias down to 2x, or turn it off, for better gameplay experience.

Kindly check if there are 100 replay files in the folder, and if so kindly delete one before starting the game. Apologies for the inconvenience caused.

notes.title: v1.02 アップデート（10月8日）

●ネットワークでの２Ｐ操作異常を修正致しました。
●戦闘時に絵が表示されない異常を修正致しました。
●Character Filterの機能を正常に修正致しました。

notes.title: v1.01 Update (01 Oct)
notes.notes:
- Fixed issue of client crashing while attempting to access network mode with invalid characters found in Steam Name.
- In a similar issue, fixed issue of client crashing while viewing leaderboards and coming across invalid Steam Names.
- Invalid characters may still be displayed incorrectly.

- Fixed issue of client hanging when user attempts to select Training Standby while matching for Ranked Matches, in network mode.

- Fixed issue of analog inputs unable to navigate the menus.

- Added support for keyboard button control settings for Up/Right/Down/Left directional inputs. Note that this only affects in-game combat, and menu navigation is still based on the default buttons. This also only affects keyboard players; Joysticks and Controller Pads controls are not affected in any way by this additional feature.

notes.title: Arcana Heart 3 LOVE MAX!!!!! Fighting Onto PC
notes.notes:
No, Arc System Works still haven’t brought Guilty Gear Xrd to PC. Their cruelty continues, as today they announced they’re instead bringing Arcana Heart 3 LOVE MAX!!!!! [official site] our way next and I did not change the punctuation or capitalisation of that name at all because it is amazing.

The all-female fighting game developed by Examu was first released to arcades in 2009, then consoles in 2011, and will finally come to Windows on September 29th. Come observe anime schoolgirls, witches, and goodness knows who else beating the heck out of each other with some pleasingly colourful special moves:
